CITY OF SAN MARINO

  DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE AGENDA

Christa Lakon, Chair  www.cityofsanmarino.org
Sharon Mequet, Vice-Chair  (626) 300-0711 Phone
Raymond Cheng, Member  (626) 300-0716 Fax
Joyce Gatsoulis-Batnij, Member  City Hall Council Chamber
Rich Chou, Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Tony Chou, Alternate  San Marino, CA 91108
Suzanne Torgeson, Alternate

  MEETING OF THE SAN MARINO
  DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE
  WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 2, 2022 AT 6:00 P.M.
  VIA TELECONFERENCE &
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS, SAN MARINO CITY HALL
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Design
Review Committee with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Meetings are held on the 1st and 3rd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. via Teleconference
and at the Council Chambers, San Marino City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive San Marino,
CA 91108.

In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a
modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the
Community Development Department via email at planning@cityofsanmarino.org or by phone
at (626) 300-0700 prior to the meeting for assistance.

  PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL 361 (AB 361)
Members of the Design Review Committee may teleconference into the meeting without noticing
each teleconference location from which a member will be participating in a public meeting.

  CORONAVIRUS DISEASE (COVID-19) ADVISORY
This public hearing will be held in-person at the Crowell Public Library, Barth Community Room,
located at 1890 Huntington Drive, San Marino, CA 91108; members of the public may attend.

To protect staff, our constituents, and city officials, members of the public must follow the State
and County Health Department’s current Health Officer Orders, which require wearing a mask
indoors. Given the seriousness of COVID-19, you are encouraged to watch or listen to the
meeting from home, or provide input electronically, if you do not feel comfortable attending in
person.
 DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE AGENDA – NOVEMBER 2, 2022  PAGE 2 OF 5

Members of the public may observe and offer comment at this meeting in person, telephonically,
or otherwise electronically:

  1) Public comment will be accepted by email to planning@cityofsanmarino.org before or
  during the meeting, prior to the close of public comment on an item, to be read during
  public comment. Lengthy public comment may be summarized in the interest of time.

  2) Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module.

FOR FURTHER INFORMATION, please contact the Community Development Department
at (626) 300-0700. A copy of the staff reports under review at this Design Review Committee
meeting will be available for public review by the end of the day on October 28, 2022, on the
City’s website at: www.cityofsanmarino.org

How to participate in the meeting from home:
  1) Via Computer for Video Streaming/Zoom Meeting:
  Website: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/5719496876
  Meeting ID: 571 949 6876

  2) Via Phone for Audio Only:
  Phone Number: (669) 444-9171
  Meeting ID: 571 949 6876

  3) Submitting Public Comment
  Submit public comments via email to planning@cityofsanmarino.org. Members of
  the public participating via the Zoom web app may select the raise hand function
  prior to the close of public comment on an item. Members of the public joining
  via telephone audio can select the raise hand function by dialing *9 on the
  telephone dial pad.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL:  Chair Christa Lakon, Vice Chair Sharon Mequet, Committee Member
  Raymond Cheng, Committee Member Joyce Gatsoulis-Batnij, Committee
  Member Rick Chou, Alternate Committee Member Tony Chou, and
  Alternate Committee Member Suzanne Torgeson

POSTING OF AGENDA
This meeting agenda is being posted 72 hours prior to the meeting at the following locations:
City Hall, 2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The meeting agenda is also posted on the City’s
website: http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.
 DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE AGENDA – NOVEMBER 2, 2022  PAGE 3 OF 5

PUBLIC COMMENTS
The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Design Review
Committee on any item of interest that is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Design
Review Committee. Pursuant to state law, the Design Review Committee may not discuss or
take action on issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2).

STAFF UPDATES

  PUBLIC HEARINGS

1. DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR 21-85
  1360 GRANADA AVENUE (FU)

  The applicant proposes to construct an approximately 628 square-foot, single-story addition
  to the existing approximately 2,281 square-foot residence. The existing single-story, single-
  family home with an attached two-car garage and tennis court is located on an 11,096 square-
  foot lot in the R-1 zone, Area District VII. The proposed project requires one design review
  action pursuant to City Code Sections 23.15.03(1).

  Recommendation: Based on the information submitted to the record, staff recommends that
  the Design Review Committee 1) determine that based on the whole of the administrative
  record, that the proposed addition is exempt from CEQA pursuant to State CEQA
  Guidelines, Article 19, Sections 15331, and there is no substantial evidence demonstrating an
  exception to the categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2
  applies; and 2) find that the proposed project is compatible with the legal neighborhood and
  with the existing structure itself; and 3) approve the project with the conditions that a
  temporary construction fence be installed to minimize dust and debris alongside the
  northwest of the site, the proposed garage door be a material other than vinyl, and that the
  brick used on the proposed addition shall match in color, size, and texture with the existing
  brick found on the home.

2. DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR 21-55 and DR 22-54
  1424 BRADBURY DRIVE (SIGO GROUP MANAGEMENT, LLC)

  The applicant proposes to construct an approximately 647 square-foot, single-story addition
  and the demolition of the existing detached two-car garage with a new 441 square-foot
  detached two-car garage to the rear of the existing approximately 1,678 square-foot
  residence. The proposed 647 square-foot addition includes 113 square-foot addition to the
  front of the house, and a 534 square-foot to the rear of the house. The project site is currently
  located on a single-story, single-family home with a detached two-car garage on an 8,400
  square foot lot in the R-1 zone, Area District VI. This requires two design review actions
  pursuant to City Code Sections 23.15.03(A1)(A3).

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Design Review Committee: 1) Determine
  that based on the whole of the administrative record, that the project is exempt from CEQA
  pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines, Section 15331(Class 1 & 3), and that there is no
 DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE AGENDA – NOVEMBER 2, 2022  PAGE 4 OF 5

  substantial evidence demonstrating an exception to the categorical exemption pursuant to
  CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2 applies; 2) find that the proposed project is compatible
  with the legal Neighborhood and with the existing structure itself; and 3) staff recommends
  approval of the project with added conditions that Trees T5, T7, T8, T9, and T10 be approved
  by the City’s Urban Forester separately under a tree removal permit.

3. DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR 22-30
  1555 KENSINGTON ROAD, (CHANG & TSAI)

  The applicant proposes to construct an approximately 454 square-foot, single-story addition
  extending the side (south) elevation by more than 25% of an existing approximately 2,794
  square-foot residence. As such, it requires Design Review approval. The proposed 454
  square-foot addition will extend towards the rear yard by 22 feet to create a new master
  bedroom with closet and convert the existing master bedroom into a game room. The
  project site is currently improved with a one-story, 2,794 square-foot single-family home, a
  detached two-car garage and a guest house on an 14,924 square-foot lot in the R-1 zone,
  Area District IV. The project requires Design Review pursuant to City Code Section
  23.15.03 (A)(3).

  Recommendation: Based on the information submitted to the record, staff recommends that
  the Design Review Committee 1) determine that based on the whole of the administrative
  record, that the proposed addition is exempt from CEQA pursuant to State CEQA
  Guidelines, Article 19, Sections 15331, and there is no substantial evidence demonstrating an
  exception to the categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2
  applies; and 2) find that the proposed project is compatible with the legal neighborhood and
  with the existing structure itself; and 3) approve the project.

4. DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR 22-31
  2461 MISSION STREET (PIZZANISTA)

  The applicant is proposing to install one 10.4 square-foot individual channel letter halo-lit
  illuminated wall sign and one 2.77 square-foot illuminated blade sign for identification
  purposes of a new restaurant business known as PIZZANISTA. The wall sign fronts Mission
  Street and centers on the façade of the business. The proposed blade sign would be located
  above the main entry door of the building within the breezeway. The project is a matter
  subject to design review pursuant to San Marino City Code Section 23.15.03 (G).

  Recommendation: Based on the information submitted to the record, staff recommends
  that the Design Review Committee: (1) determine that the proposed installation of a new
  wall sign and blade sign on an existing commercial building are exempt from the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines Section 15311(a);
  (2) find that the proposed signage is compatible with signage found on adjacent commercial
  structures; and (3) approve the project as proposed with the condition to turn off the
  illuminated signs after business hours.

  CONSENT CALENDAR

5. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Design Review Committee approve the
  regular meeting of October 19, 2022.

  OTHER MATTERS

6. COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DIRECTOR’S REPORT

PUBLIC COMMENTS

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the Design Review
Committee received by Committee Members. All public writings distributed by the City to at
least a majority of the Committee Members regarding any item on this agenda will be made
available at the public counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San Marino,
California.

APPEALS

There is a fifteen day appeal period for all applications. All appeals should be filed with the City
Clerk. Please contact the City Clerk for further information.

ADJOURNMENT

The San Marino Design Review Committee will adjourn to November 16, 2022 AT 6:00 P.M.

  ISIDRO FIGUEROA
 Posted: OCTOBER 28, 2022  COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DIRECTOR
